name: The Mysterious Disappearance of Monsieur Noudelle
source:
Once more, it is time for Detective Bubbles to spring into action. After all, he is the only one who can find out why and how Monsieur Noudelle went missing... And they will do their best to bring him back!

[from [url=https://tan-tan.itch.io/the-mysterious-disappearance-of-monsieur-noudelle]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
泡泡侦探再一次采取行动了。毕竟，他是唯一一个能够查明努德尔先生失踪原因和方式的人……而且他们会尽最大努力把他带回来！

[来自[url=https://tan-tan.itch.io/the-mysterious-disappearance-of-monsieur-noudelle]Itch.io[/url]]
